name: Swarm
description: 蜂群：一个协调者把活拆给几个独立会话，通过共享消息板协作，侧栏是 AGY 的原版看板（Board / Members / Graph / Raw）。

agentTools.name: swarm
agentTools.description: Manage the swarm in this conversation. open creates it (this session becomes the coordinator), add posts a brief and tells you how to spawn the worker, kill stops a member, title names the swarm, status lists every member with role, state and post counts. bind is for a worker: call it once with the key from its brief so the board knows which session it is.

action.description: What to do. Defaults to status.

title.description: For open/title: the swarm's name, 2-6 words.

name.description: For add/kill: lowercase member name, e.g. parser, verifier, narrator.

brief.description: For add: the worker's whole assignment. It is posted on the board and is the only context the new worker starts with.

role.description: For add: worker (default), narrator (owns the Overview), or monitor (watches for stalls).

model.description: For add: optional model id the worker should run on.

key.description: For bind: the key the brief gives you, e.g. "a1b2c3d4".

agentTools.name: swarm_post
agentTools.description: Say something on the swarm's shared board. Addressing is the doorbell: @name wakes that member, @all wakes everyone, @#channel reaches a channel. Every post costs the people you address a turn.

text.description: The post. Start with @name when you are assigning work to someone.

channel.description: Optional channel id; omit for main.

agentTools.name: swarm_read
agentTools.description: Read the swarm board, newest last. Pass since to get only newer posts. Use it before deciding, not instead of swarm_wait.

since.description: Only posts with a higher seq.

agentTools.name: swarm_wait
agentTools.description: Sleep on the board until someone posts, then return the new posts. Waiting costs nothing; polling the board in a loop costs a turn each time. Call again with the returned head as since.

since.description: The highest seq you have actually read.

mentionsOnly.description: Only wake for posts that @ you or @all (the coordinator usually wants false).

agentTools.name: swarm_view
agentTools.description: Narrator only: publish the pane's Overview. Pass view (the view.json object: headline, phase, attention[], workstreams, milestones, risks, feedback_ack, reel.frames[]) or html (a static page).

view.description: The Overview contract, written to view.json.

html.description: Optional static page, written to view.html.

agentTools.name: swarm_plan
agentTools.description: Publish the swarm's plan, which the pane's Overview draws: goal, each member's task in a few words, and 1-6 threads grouping work by outcome. Call it again when the plan changes. Never write plan.json yourself.

agentTypes.name: swarm:worker
agentTypes.description: 蜂群里的一个工作者：读板、干活、在板上报结果，然后睡回板上等下一个 @。

agentTypes.name: swarm:verifier
agentTypes.description: 蜂群里的验证者：只报告不修改，审别人交上来的活。

agentTypes.name: swarm:narrator
agentTypes.description: 蜂群的讲述者：读板并在每轮重写侧栏 Overview（view.json）。不派活、不改代码。

agentTypes.name: swarm:monitor
agentTypes.description: 蜂群的僵局监视器：定时看板，只在全员都在等、活又没干完时点名协调者。
